title: Keyboard not typing
symptom: Keyboard types nothing, but the mouse still works
user_description: Hi, my keyboard stopped working. I press keys and nothing appears, but my mouse is fine. I have to finish a letter!

options.why: Far too drastic. The mouse works, so Windows is running fine. Never start with the most destructive fix.

options.text: Check the keyboard is plugged in firmly (or its batteries and receiver if wireless), then try another USB port
options.why: A working mouse shows the PC is fine, so the problem is almost always the keyboard connection, batteries or USB port. Check the simple physical things first.

options.text: Order a new keyboard straight away
options.why: Wastes money and time. A loose cable or flat batteries are far more likely than a dead keyboard.
Risky and unrelated. A BIOS update can cause serious problems and has nothing to do with one dead keyboard.

hints: The mouse works, so is the whole PC the problem?
How does the keyboard connect to the PC?
real_world_tip: Swap in a spare keyboard from the cupboard. If it works, you know the old keyboard is the fault and the user can keep working while you sort it out.
